name: Charism
overview: The Scriptures reveal that charisms are divinely inspired gifts granted specifically to the apostles and early believers, enabling them to perform miraculous works such as healing the sick, casting out demons, and even raising the dead. These gifts, given by Christ as seen in His commissioning of the twelve disciples and the seventy, served as signs accompanying their ministry to confirm the message of the kingdom of God. The power to heal, speak in new tongues, and protect from harm underscores the supernatural empowerment bestowed on the early church for the advancement of the gospel.
